tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas on Web and Mobile.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, dialogs, popovers, the Mobile navigator chrome.

tokens.name: background-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: poster placeholders, subtle badges, secondary buttons, hover on ghost controls, sheet inputs on Mobile.

tokens.name: background-strong
tokens.usage: Skeleton pulse and the icon disc in a poster's failed-image fallback.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on background, background-elevated and background-subtle.

tokens.name: foreground-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and meta lines on background, background-elevated, background-subtle and accent-subtle. In light it is slate-500 darkened by 3% lightness: 4.8:1 on background-subtle, 5.0:1 on background.

tokens.name: foreground-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, footers and de-emphasised captions on background and background-elevated. An alias of foreground-muted: no lighter step reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary fills, the watched pill, filled stars, the active nav underline, progress bars. It is a fill and a graphic colour, and carries accent-foreground. For amber text use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Amber as a text colour on background, background-elevated and accent-subtle: links, View all, accent badges, active tabs. Over 6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-text-hover
tokens.usage: Hover colour for accent-text links.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on an accent fill, in both themes. Over 7:1 on accent.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Accent badge fill, input focus halo, text-selection background. Carries accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-muted
tokens.usage: A stronger amber wash than accent-subtle for highlighted rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline on cards, inputs and dividers. Decorative strength: it does not reach 3:1 on its grounds.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on cards and secondary buttons; scrollbar thumb; off-state switch track on Mobile.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Faint dividers inside a surface. Web only.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn alias for card surfaces.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: shadcn alias for popovers, menus, dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn alias: default Button fill, checked Switch track, Tooltip fill.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn alias for quiet fills.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn alias for secondary text; the placeholder tint on Mobile.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on background and background-elevated; the outlined destructive button on Mobile. Pair it with a word or icon: it differs from success by hue only.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive-solid.

tokens.name: destructive-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive Button. Stays red-600 in both themes because it carries white labels; the brighter dark destructive only reaches 3.8:1 under white.

tokens.name: destructive-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a destructive Button.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons and toasts. About 3:1 on light surfaces, so use it for icons, not body text, and always beside a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and toasts. About 3:1 on light surfaces, so use it for icons, not body text.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input borders and the unchecked Switch track.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, always opaque: a 2px outline with a 2px offset on buttons, a 3px ring on Select and Switch. Over 6:1 on background in both themes.
